mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Use the attached reference images, each for one purpose.
Reference image 1 is a style reference only: match its flat posterized colour fills, thin dark ink outlines, small ink tick marks and muted palette; do not copy its subject.
Reference image 2 is the SCENE to keep: draw exactly this same shore, keeping the misty grey mountains, the dark fir forest on the right, the calm grey water of the bay, the shingle beach of rounded dark grey stones in the foreground and the weathered grey driftwood mooring post standing upright on the right with rope wound round it, in the same layout and camera position. Change only this: remove the outrigger canoe, its float, its outrigger poles and the paddle completely. Where the canoe was there are only more rounded stones and shallow water.
Subject: an empty stony shore with a single weathered driftwood mooring post standing upright at the waterline, a short length of rope tied round the post with its loose end lying coiled on the stones at its foot, no boat of any kind.
The ground is untouched: no footprints, no tracks, no drag marks, no prints of any kind.
Style: Card Survival Fantasy Forest game card art. Flat posterized colour fills in a few hard-edged tonal steps, cel-like, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no paper texture. Thin dark ink outlines and small ink hatch and tick marks for texture. Muted naturalistic palette. Realistic proportions, nothing glossy, no fantasy glow. The painted scene reaches every edge of the frame. No text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: canoe, boat, outrigger, raft, paddle, oar, footprints, tracks, prints or marks in the ground, drag marks, birds, gulls, people, photo, photorealistic, 3D render, anime, pixel art, neon colours, lens flare, watercolour, soft gradients, text, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, plain white background, vignette, white border.
